idea_title: Residual mixing of neural weight extension (alpha=0.2)
notes: Reduced RESIDUAL_ALPHA from 1.0 to 0.2. nmaxe dropped 77.4% (2.386->0.540). Attention mixing preserves RHS signal while allowing neural correction.
Further reduced RESIDUAL_ALPHA to 0.1. nmaxe dropped additional 48% (0.540->0.279). Less neural weight = better results, confirming attention is destructive.
Final evaluation after optimization. Residual mixing with alpha=0.1 preserves 90% original RHS while allowing 10% neural weight contribution.
